VTS Scoring Log

Limitless Life Nootropics / Limitless Biotech

US-facing gray market· Lyophilized vials, capsules, sprays· Scored July 2026· limitlesslifenootropics.com →
68 /100
Moderate Transparency
One of the stronger testing frameworks in the market. Three independent labs including an FDA-DEA certified facility, GMP manufacturing, and multi-parameter testing (HPLC, LC-MS, sterility, endotoxin). Primary gap: no public searchable COA database by batch number. COA access is per-order rather than open. Established multi-year operation.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
Community members in peptide research forums have referenced Limitless as a vendor for impurity profiles, with one commonly cited observation that their COA detail exceeds most competitors. No recent independently-commissioned blind-buy tests identified in public archives as of July 2026.
Community Experience
Limitless Life Nootropics has consistent community presence in r/Peptides discussions, generally referenced as a reliable established source. Positive signals on catalog breadth and COA availability. Some community members note the login-required pricing as a friction point for evaluation before purchase.
Scoring Notes
The strongest testing posture on this list
Three independent labs including an FDA-DEA certified facility is a meaningfully higher bar than single-lab or in-house testing. The comprehensive parameter list (HPLC, LC-MS, sterility, endotoxin, contaminants) covers what actually matters for a buyer's safety. The score is held at Moderate primarily by the absence of a public COA database.
What would move the score to High Transparency
A public, searchable COA library by lot number - the same infrastructure Ascension Peptides and Verified Peptides have built - would push this into High Transparency territory given the strength of the underlying testing protocol. The gap is in public accessibility, not in what appears to be genuine testing rigor.
